comment: License safety knowledge for the forestpm registry, in the context of closed-source commercial games (forest's primary audience). All user-facing copy must present ratings as automated review, not legal advice.

caveats: Share-alike: adaptations of the licensed material must be shared under the same license, and attribution is required. Written for creative works rather than code — its obligations in a bundled game are legally untested.
Modified versions must be clearly marked as changed.
The copyright notice must be preserved in copies.
The copyright notice must be preserved in copies. The author's name may not be used to promote your product.
Modified files must carry a notice of changes. If the package ships a NOTICE file, its attributions must be preserved.
File-level copyleft: if you modify this package's own source files, those modified files must be made available under MPL-2.0. Using it unmodified in a closed-source game is fine.
Weak copyleft: modifications to the package itself must be published under EPL-2.0. Using it unmodified is generally fine.
File-level copyleft: modified source files must remain under CDDL. Using it unmodified is generally fine.

LGPL assumes users can swap out the library. In a bundled Roblox game that boundary is murky — modifying the package creates source obligations, and even unmodified use is legally untested in this context.

LGPL assumes users can swap out the library. In a bundled Roblox game that boundary is murky — modifying the package creates source obligations, and even unmodified use is legally untested in this context.
Strong copyleft: shipping this in your game plausibly requires releasing your game's entire source under GPL-3.0. Not recommended for closed-source projects.
Strong copyleft: shipping this in your game plausibly requires releasing your game's entire source under GPL-2.0. Not recommended for closed-source projects.

Strongest copyleft: even network use counts as distribution, so running this in a live game plausibly requires releasing your game's entire source under AGPL-3.0. Not recommended for closed-source projects.

textFingerprintsComment: Deterministic license-text identification. Evaluate IN ORDER against text normalized to lowercase with all whitespace runs collapsed to single spaces; a rule matches when every allOf substring is present AND (anyOf is absent or at least one anyOf substring is present). First match wins; no match = null. Order matters: AGPL/LGPL texts contain 'general public license', so the specific ones come first; BSD-3 precedes BSD-2 as its stricter superset.
